time, L.

a: वरूथं — [वृ ऊथन् Uṇ. 2. 6] 1 A sort of wooden fence or fender with which a chariot is provided as a defence against collision (m. also in this sense); वरूथो रथगुप्तिर्या तिरोधत्ते रथस्थितिम्. --2 An armour, a coat of mail. --3 A shield. --4 A group, multitude, an assemblage. --5 Protection. --6 A family. --7 A house, residence (Ved. in the last {3} senses). --थः 1 The cuckoo. --2 Time.
